access_control.custodian: A nonselecting bounded compiler process may stream the mixed custodied envelopes to filter train/dev. JSON parsing may decode sealed payload bytes transiently: this is custody, not selector/model access. Never claim sealed payloads were not decoded when a complete JSON envelope parser ran. Do not project, log, export, fit or choose using calibration/confirmation/unused contents.
access_control.manifest_gate: Commit compiler code before materialization. Freeze output hashes, ordered component/group/row/decision membership hashes and per-endpoint/per-locale coverage/type summaries before selectors read train/dev.
access_control.selector_reader: Accept only exact train/dev role, rooted output path, manifest-hashed completed projection and registered protocol/compiler provenance. Deny sealed/unused/unknown phases before opening any data. Do not expose mixed-source file handles or payloads to selectors.
access_control.source_schema: Validate source membership and selected payload shape/type before output. Nonselected payload contents do not become diagnostics.

artifacts_to_persist: All named separated outputs and immutable manifests
Exact native rater/missingness and coverage ledgers
Independent reconstruction receipt and failure receipt if any
No model output or calibration/final target exports
controls: Independent original-field reconstruction of classification IDs, native rater arrays/frequencies/means and immutable membership
Serving reconstruction from DecisionIR via pinned renderer with no annotation-bearing fields
Rejected sealed-phase access; no partial manifest accepted
Publication manifest retains source/IR/renderer/catalogue/compiler/protocol hashes and source-role denominators

data.allocation: Reuse every selected existing source row and original input-only connected component. No reallocation, downsampling, cap changes, task/label-driven membership or moved confirmation. Component IDs remain statistical grouping units; all translations, ratings and endpoints remain descendants.
data.exposure: Public and legacy benchmark/model exposure disclosed. Study sealing is not universal freshness.
data.license: shipping-train source class as recorded, CC-BY-4.0 dataset-specific grants; preserve attribution, publisher references and modification notice; no raw rows or labels in Git
data.release: Original Banking77 and MASSIVE1.1 custody; original fixed51locale membership

evidence_class: HYPOTHESIS source-native compiler; referenced metadata identities MEASURED

failure_branches.missing_ratings: Report truthful source coverage; unavailable endpoint stays unmeasured. No imputation or target invention.
failure_branches.pass: Freeze projection result manifest, then preregister appropriate model/control/route/calibration development experiment. Compiler pass earns no model capability, promotion or endgame completion.
failure_branches.schema_or_source_hash: Fail closed, retain failure and partial outputs outside selector serving. Document implementation-only correction with original lineage; no changed membership/targets based on model quality.
failure_branches.unsupported_capability: Keep all21 endpoints, arbitrary criteria, generic Boolean, naturalK>=255/1000, multilingual non-intent, long context and other gaps unmeasured; open a separate justified source/mechanism protocol.

gates.native_types: Zero invalid present selected labels/rating types; missing preserved, not a failure or invented target
gates.phase_isolation: Only train/dev outputs, sealed phase reader requests fail before file access
gates.source_membership: Exact existing train/dev membership and source-role totals

hypothesis: A source-native projection can preserve immutable source membership and original categorical/ordinal judgments in DecisionIR and separated target ledgers without leaking gold into serving input or exposing sealed phases to selectors. This is compiler correctness, not semantic quality.
primary_metric: Exact source-native projection agreement for all selected records/endpoints, target arrays, serving bytes and membership

choice.candidates: Full pinned publisher catalogue:K77/K60, same order and IDs on every row; underscores-to-spaces descriptions only. Never remove classes using source labels.
choice.gold: Original category/intent string must match exactly one catalogue ID; never fuzzy-match, relabel or infer unknown.
choice.question: Which intent best matches this utterance?

forbidden_surrogates: intent_score/slots_score as ordinal or generic Boolean
score/classification rows as independent extra n
projection.ids: SHA256 of canonical [source_row.row_key, endpoint_id]; no gold/rating or label content in IDs. Preserve row_key/group_id/component_id in provenance.

ordinal.IR_gold: Empty tuple: no fabricated single gold, rounded mean, majority target or accepted-label set. Target distribution is carried separately.
ordinal.missing: Emit unlabeled endpoint with target_available=false and no empirical target when no valid native ratings exist; retain coverage/missingness ledger and original intent row. Do not fabricate English ratings.
ordinal.question_and_candidates: Exact pinned original publisher prompt and level descriptions; grammar5levels0..4, spelling3levels0..2. No five-bin spelling rescale.
ordinal.semantics: Filtered/source-retained rater distribution, not workforce/population probabilities. Spelling distances are native bin distances, not expected error counts. Shared workers across groups are not independent new n.
ordinal.targets: Preserve original rater order, each present native integer value, missing/null distinction and per-rater field mask; exclude JSON bool and reject unsupported types/ranges. Preserve source missingness. Empirical categorical frequencies and mean level use only observed valid raters; do not impute or replicate a mean into raters.

projection.provenance: Source ID/revision/file/line/row/group/component/official partition/current role/input fingerprint, licence and modifications; raw worker identifiers stay in original private custody, never in serving or stdout.
projection.serialization: Finite canonical UTF8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, lists retain source order; reproducible gzip mtime0. Refuse overwrites and incomplete manifests.
projection.serving: Use pinned state_text/question_text/candidate_text renderer. Only id/task and rendered state/question/candidates plus explicit input locale for identical routing. IR gold, source/group IDs, split, license, annotations, evidence/targets and metadata are excluded from model text.
projection.state: Exactly one non-exact StateBlock(id=utterance,text=original text/utt). No normalization, annotated utterance, scenario, intent, worker, rating or label text enters state.

secondary_metrics: Selected source rows/component/group counts versus original custody
Per-locale/per-endpoint observed/missing/invalid type counts without model outputs
No extra candidate classes, duplicated raters, rescaled spelling labels or worker leakage
statistical_test: Deterministic full-population independent reconstruction and exact-byte hashes; no sampled quality inference or CI
status: PROSPECTIVE; commit before source projection and selector exposure
